title: A Gravity for the Horizon Again
author: Ansel Delacroix
blurb: Freya Sandoval, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
